channel.title: Business services: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the business services sector.

item.title: EcoSimplex: EcoSimplex signed a KRW 952.9m first-year contract with Sudokwon Landfill Site Management Corp. for landfill power generation facility operation.
Cheil Worldwide: Cheil Worldwide decided to buy back 3,291,278 common shares for KRW 60.0bn on-market from November 25, 2026 to January 29, 2027.
Ecoeye: Ecoeye signs KRW 3.65bn emissions credit sale contract with Louis Dreyfus Company Suisse SA, equal to 11.8% of recent revenue.
MOA Life Plus: Moa Life Plus amended its April 2026 convertible bond issuance filing to withdraw the decision, citing contract cancellation.
Voronoi: Voronoi's board resolved on Nov 13, 2026 to issue KRW 52.7bn of Series 5 private convertible bonds for working capital.
Mobidays: Mobidays reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 10.7bn and operating profit of KRW 1.4bn, both down year over year.
NGeneBio: NGeneBio's board decided a KRW 6.0bn third-party allotment of 6,000,000 new common shares at KRW 1,000 per share to its largest shareholder.
NGeneBio: NGeneBio will issue 2,000,000 new common shares at KRW 1,000 to its largest shareholder via third-party allotment, raising KRW 2.0bn for debt repayment.
Gridwiz: Gridwiz decided to absorb its wholly owned subsidiary IDR Service in a small-scale merger, with the merger date set for January 1, 2027.
HS Ad: HS Ad reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 87.5bn and operating profit of KRW 7.1bn, up 36.57% year on year.
Innocean Worldwide: Innocean's Q3 2026 consolidated revenue was KRW 510.9bn and operating profit KRW 49.2bn, the latter down 4.2% year on year.
Proteina: Proteina decides third-party allotment of 151,886 registered convertible preferred shares at KRW 48,061 each, raising about KRW 7.30bn.
Proteina: Proteina decided to issue KRW 29.2bn of unsecured private-placement convertible bonds, maturing 12 November 2031, with a conversion price of KRW 48,061.
Hanatour Service: Hana Tour's Q3 2026 consolidated revenue was KRW 111.7bn, down 9.40% YoY, with operating profit of KRW 5.1bn.
Lotte Tour Development: Lotte Tour Development reported October 2026 consolidated casino revenue of KRW 62.5bn (62,526 million won), up 24.1% year on year.
